results.title: Mona McSharry and Ellie McCartney advance at European Championships
results.description: McSharry, who claimed silver in the 100m Breaststroke on Wednesday night in a new Irish record time, returned to action less than 15 hours later and looked comfortable as she clocked 2:23.37 in the 50m heats.

results.title: Enzo Fernandez: What we know as Chelsea set Man City transfer deadline for £120m Argentina star
results.description: Enzo Maresca wants to be reunited with his midfield talisman in Manchester and Chelsea have laid down clear terms to make a mega money deal happen.
